newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat bounces as volume stays high.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat bounces as volume stays high.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) wheat futures stayed active as prices bounced on Wednesday.
A total of 66 contracts changed hands, down from Tuesday's 87 but well up on the normal volume.
The January, March and May contracts again traded on spreads, all rising by A$2.00 a tonne to A$168.50, A$171.00 and A$174.00 respectively.
Garry Hopper of ANZ Futures said the market was drawing strength from drought and from merchant support.
But Hopper does not see Wednesday's rise as the start of a rally.
